summary.title: VINGNES EIENDOM AS

narrative.text: VINGNES EIENDOM AS is a Norwegian private limited company in "Utleie av egen eller leid fast eiendom", registered 2014-06-23.
Registered activity: Investere i fast eiendom eller selskaper som eier fast eiendom, og alt som dermed står i forbindelse.
Latest filed legal-entity accounts for 2025 show revenue of NOK 567,762 and an annual result of NOK -19,391.
Registered leadership: Eirik Ingebrigt Fossum (Styrets leder).
Head office in Oslo, with 1 registered workplace.
Not established from permitted exact-entity sources: brand, group, website, company profiles, jobs, public activity. This is not proof of absence.
